evidence.notes: Client certificate configuration for SOAP callouts requires org-level certificate management that the local runtime does not model.
Continuation (asynchronous) SOAP callouts require server-side long-running callout management that the local runtime does not support.
SOAP API end-of-life policy is a Salesforce platform lifecycle concern, not a local runtime behavior.
SOAP web service callouts from Apex require WebServiceCallout support, which the local runtime does not implement.
Custom SOAP header management requires WebServiceCallout framework support, which the local runtime does not implement.
SOAP XML namespace handling requires WebServiceCallout framework support, which the local runtime does not implement.
The Tooling SOAP API is a server-side API endpoint; the local glade server does not implement a Tooling SOAP surface.
